_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Klondike Solitaire. Your goal is to move all cards to the foundation piles.

Game Rules:
- Foundation piles (F1-F4): Build up from Ace to King in suit
- Tableau piles (T1-T7): Build down alternating colors (red on black, black on red)
- Stock: Draw cards to waste pile
- Waste (W): Top card available for play

Commands:
- 'draw' - Draw cards from stock to waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Move cards between piles
  Examples: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count can also be 'all', which will try to move all face-up cards.
- 'forfeit' - End the game immediately and lock in your current score
- Pile names: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

You can execute multiple actions in one turn by separating them with commas:
  Example: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Only Kings can be placed on empty tableau piles.
Actions execute in order - if one fails, the remaining actions are skipped.
Use 'forfeit' if you believe the game is impossible to win.
